themes.name: Server attitude and attentiveness
themes.description: Friendliness, rudeness, attentiveness, and knowledge of servers and bartenders, including being ignored, forgotten, or having multiple servers rotate through the table.

themes.name: Host stand and wait times
themes.description: Experiences with hostesses, seating policies, reservations, walk-ins, and how long guests waited for a table despite empty seats or reservations.

themes.name: Pacing and order timing
themes.description: How quickly or slowly food and drinks arrived, courses coming out all at once or out of order, and diners feeling rushed or left waiting.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Comments on whether dishes were over-salted, bland, under-seasoned, or well-seasoned and flavorful.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Opinions on the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, chewiness, sauce, and whether it lived up to its reputation.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Reactions to the wood-fired or roasted oysters with chili garlic butter, including size, sauce, freshness, and cooking.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon dish
themes.description: Reviews of the signature pulled-pork Louisiana Cochon patty with cabbage, cracklins, and pickled peaches, including dryness, flavor, and temperature.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Opinions on the rabbit and dumplings stew or entree, including tenderness, richness, seasoning, and amount of rabbit.

themes.name: Pork ribs and pork cuts
themes.description: Comments on smoked ribs with watermelon pickle, pork cheeks, ham hock, brisket and similar meat dishes, including tenderness, sauce, spice, and fattiness.

themes.name: Sides and mac and cheese
themes.description: Opinions on side dishes such as mac and cheese, grits, smothered greens, and eggplant and shrimp dressing.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Comments on the complimentary rolls and bread basket, including quality, butter, and whether bread was delayed, refused, or never delivered.

themes.name: Boudin and charcuterie
themes.description: Reactions to boudin balls, the boucherie plate, head cheese, fried livers, and other house-made charcuterie and small meat plates.

themes.name: Price and portion size
themes.description: Whether prices felt fair relative to portion sizes, quality, and the amount of food, including small plates and high check totals.

themes.name: Noise and seating comfort
themes.description: Comments on loudness, acoustics, cramped tables, hard chairs, temperature, and outdoor seating conditions.

themes.name: Decor and atmosphere
themes.description: Opinions on the restaurant's look, vibe, lighting, open kitchen, and overall ambiance and trendiness.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Reviews comparing the restaurant to its reputation, awards, and other reviews, and to other New Orleans restaurants or Cochon Butcher.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Comments on the cocktails, beer, wine list, moonshine, bar program, and other beverages.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Opinions on desserts such as pineapple upside-down cake, pies, puddings, and cakes.
